results.title: Max Planck Institute student internship & HiWi (MPI-MP, Golm)
results.organization: Max Planck Institute for Molecular Plant Physiology
results.freshness_reason: Rolling; no fixed deadline, contact group leaders directly several months ahead; opportunities are limited/competitive.
results.eligibility_notes: HiWi restricted to students enrolled at a German university (not yet completed MSc); Internship open to BSc/MSc in Germany or abroad. Persona is a Germany-based Biology undergrad (EU) -> satisfies both; specific group fit to be confirmed by enquiry.
results.notes: Apply by emailing group leaders with CV + motivation; not a central portal.

results.title: iGEM Competition (form a team at your own university)
results.freshness_reason: 2026 team registration is now closed; 2027 cycle typically opens ~January 2027. Monitor official site.
results.eligibility_notes: Open to undergraduate student teams; any university can form a team. Strong fit with biology + genomics/data interests (wetlab + drylab roles).
results.notes: Ideal for genomics/data angle; start a team at your German/Dutch university.

results.title: Biozentrum Research Summer 2027 (University of Basel)
results.freshness_reason: 2027 application window Jan 2 - Feb 25 2027 (per aggregator draft); 2026 cycle passed. Official confirmation pending.
results.eligibility_notes: Bachelor students in Biology/related; due to labor law only Swiss or EU nationality (or C permit) admitted -> persona EU citizen qualifies. Prior research experience not required.
results.notes: Canonical Source Gate: no official_url found (only an aggregator draft page). Confirm directly on University of Basel Biozentrum official site before acting.

results.title: Vienna Biocenter Summer School (Fully Funded)
results.freshness_reason: 2027 intake not yet officially announced; only aggregator summaries available.
results.eligibility_notes: Undergraduate + completed >=2 years by 30 June; good academic record; English required. Persona (2nd year, by summer 2027 ~3 yrs) likely qualifies.
results.notes: Canonical Source Gate: no official_url found; 2027 not announced. Track official VBC page.

results.title: LMU Biology Faculty HiWi / research assistant posts
results.freshness_reason: Faculty posts HiWi/research-assistant openings on a rolling basis each semester.
results.eligibility_notes: HiWi posts appear tied to LMU enrollment; persona's specific university unknown -> cannot confirm eligibility.
results.notes: Direct German-locale find; confirm LMU enrollment requirement.

results.title: University of Groningen Bachelor Biology research project
results.freshness_reason: Degree-embedded 12 ECTS scientific internship / research project, undertaken during the bachelor.
results.eligibility_notes: Requires enrollment in RUG Bachelor Biology; persona not confirmed at RUG.
results.notes: Dutch-locale find. Not a separately advertised opportunity - it is a degree component; NL public search mostly returned admissions pages, standalone undergrad research posts are HiWi-style (contact departments directly).

results.title: Biologie-Sommerschule (Würzburg)
results.freshness_reason: Annual school; 2024 edition required finished 10th grade.
results.eligibility_notes: Requirement: finished 10th grade (school pupils), not university undergraduates.
results.notes: Audience is secondary-school pupils, not undergrads.

results.title: EMBL Lautenschläger Summer School 'Visualising Life'
results.freshness_reason: 2026 edition ran 13-24 July 2026 and has already ended.
results.eligibility_notes: Targets advanced Bachelor/Master students from Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, Math, CS (non-biology backgrounds); persona is a Biology major -> poor fit.

results.title: iGEM Stockholm 2027 team
results.freshness_reason: 2027 team applications are closed (per official team page).
results.eligibility_notes: Requires enrollment at a Stockholm university; persona is in Germany/Netherlands.
results.notes: Closed and geographically restricted; the general iGEM Competition (entry #2) is the applicable path.

run_notes: Round-2 fixes verified on an already-strong persona: (1) Freshness Gate - every item carries a freshness value; (2) Canonical Source Gate - Biozentrum Basel and Vienna Biocenter were demoted to worth_verifying because no official_url was found (only aggregator/draft pages); (3) Budget split - 6 searches + 6 fetches, discovery_fetches=0 / verification_fetches=6 (>=half reserved for top-candidate verification); (4) Locale inheritance - de-DE and nl-NL queries used for exploit/adjacent; English reserved for EU/international optional recall (minor caveat: the explore iGEM query ran in English because the program is inherently international). Verification rate of recommended_now = 100% (2/2), up from round-1's 62% - clear improvement, no regression. NL standalone undergrad research posts are scarce in public search (mostly admissions pages); represented via the Groningen degree-embedded item.
